{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the premises
print("Shape:", df.shape)
print("\nFirst few rows:")
print(df.head())

# Verify 'converted' is binary
print("\nUnique values in 'converted':", df['converted'].unique())

# Verify 'customer_age' contains -1 as sentinel
print("\nCount of age == -1:", (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())
print("\nUnique ages:", sorted(df['customer_age'].unique()))

# Check for fake revenue rows (should not affect age, but good to confirm)
print("\nRevenue values (top 10):", df['revenue'].unique()[:10])
print("\nCount of revenue == 999999.99:", (df['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum())"}
